description: Official .NET SDK for Tahsilat.com payment gateway integration
releaseNotes:
Updated v1.2.0 =>
				FIXES
				- Customers.Delete / Products.Delete answered 415: the DELETE request carried no Content-Type. Fixed
				- Customers.Search / Products.Search never worked: wrong parameters (keyword/sources) and the response is a { meta, items } page, not a list. Rewritten, see BREAKING
				- Access token was not refreshed on servers running in UTC+3 (DateTime Kind mismatch); expires_at is now a DateTimeOffset. Safety margin 5 min -> 60 s
				- A token rejected by the server (403 + error_code 1002, or 401) now triggers one token refresh and one retry
				- Metadata values are sent verbatim; "İstanbul şubesi" no longer becomes "_stanbul _ubesi"
				- Commissions.Search sent bin_number in the GET body, which the API ignored; filters now go in the query string
				- Webhook replay protection is ON by default (5 minutes). Pass WebhookHandler.DisableTimestampCheck to opt out
				- ResolvePreAuth (sync) now returns ApiResponse<PreAuthResolveResponse> like ResolvePreAuthAsync

				SUBSCRIPTIONS (recurring payments)
				- ProductCreateRequest/ProductUpdateRequest: IsRecurring, BillingInterval (enum), IntervalCount
				- ProductResponse: IsRecurring, BillingInterval, IntervalCount, RecurringText, PaymentLink (object: HasPaymentLink), EditLock (Locked + Reason when an active subscription locks the product), Subscription (HasSubscription). CustomerResponse: PaymentLink, Notes, Subscription
				- PaymentCreateRequest: SubscriptionCredentialId, WhiteLabel, InstallmentCount
				- TransactionResult and WebhookEvent: Subscription block (SubscriptionInfo) + HasSubscription/GetSubscriptionId/GetSubscriptionCycleNumber/IsInitialSubscriptionPayment/GetSubscriptionStatusTextTr. WebhookEvent: FormattedAmount
				- SubscriptionStatus and BillingInterval enums

				NEW
				- Products.UpdateMetadata(Async): POST products/update-metadata/{id}; the list REPLACES the product's metadata
				- TahsilatValidationException.Errors: field errors as a dictionary ("*" for messages not tied to a field)
				- TahsilatConflictException for 409
				- Transport failures (connect, timeout, dropped connection) surface as TahsilatNetworkException with InnerException and are retried where safe: connect failures for every request, timeouts only for GET and the token request. TahsilatClientOptions.MaxNetworkRetries (default 3)
				- TahsilatClientOptions.HttpMessageHandler for proxies, logging and tests
				- Default timeout 30 s -> 80 s; TLS 1.2 forced on net452; connection recycling on net8.0/net9.0; User-Agent carries the package version
				- Unit test project (tests/Tahsilat.NET.Tests) driving the client through a scripted HttpMessageHandler

				BREAKING
				- SearchAsync(string)/Search(string) replaced by SearchAsync(CustomerSearchRequest)/SearchAsync(ProductSearchRequest) returning CustomerSearchResponse/ProductSearchResponse. ProductSearchRequest.Keyword/PageSize removed
				- A 2xx answer with "status": false (bank rejected a refund or pre-auth resolve) now throws TahsilatApiException (StatusCode 200, ErrorCode from the API) instead of returning Data = null. Replace Status checks with try/catch
				- Webhooks older than 5 minutes are rejected unless DisableTimestampCheck is passed
				- HttpRequestException/TaskCanceledException are no longer thrown raw; catch TahsilatNetworkException
				- ResolvePreAuth (sync) returns the envelope; read .Data for the old value
				- Removed unused public types: ITahsilatLogger, ConsoleLogger, NullLogger, TahsilatLogLevel, TahsilatEnvironment, TransactionQueryRequest, BinLookupRequest, and TahsilatClientOptions.Logger

			Updated v1.1.1 =>
				- Documentation only, no code changes. The v1.1.0 README incorrectly stated that TahsilatNetworkException covers connection failures and timeouts. It does not: it maps to an HTTP 424 response. A timeout surfaces as TaskCanceledException and a connection failure as HttpRequestException, and neither is caught by catch (TahsilatException)
				- Added a "Timeout ve Baglanti Hatalari" section explaining that the SDK never retries automatically, that a timed out mutating call (payment, refund, pre-auth resolve) may still have been processed by the server, and that you must re-query the transaction before retrying instead of resending blindly

			Updated v1.1.0 =>
				- BREAKING: removed the unused RefundService and the TahsilatClient.Refunds property. Refunds now have a single entry point: Transactions.RefundAsync(request) / Transactions.Refund(request)
				- RefundCreateRequest.Amount is now nullable (int?). Leave it null to refund the full transaction amount; provide a value (in kurus, min 100) for a partial refund
				- Documented that the refund endpoint never populates the response Data field (it is always null). Read the outcome from Status and Message; a bank rejection returns Status false instead of an HTTP error
				- PaymentCreateRequest.RedirectUrl is now string? to match its optional semantics. If omitted, the customer is redirected to Tahsilat's own payment result page instead of your site
				- BREAKING: CommissionResponse.CompanyPosCredentialId is now nullable (long?). Use ?? 0 or .Value where you previously assigned it to a long
				- CommissionResponse: added the card dimension fields that make each rate unique - PosId, PosName, CardType, IsOnUs, IsForeign - plus the previously missing InstallmentText. A row is now identified by Installment + CardType + IsOnUs + IsForeign
				- CardType is null when the rate applies to all card types; IsOnUs is null when it applies both to on-us and not-on-us transactions. Compare CardType against the new Tahsilat.NET.Models.Common.CardTypes constants (Credit/Debit/Prepaid)
				- BEHAVIOUR: Commissions.SearchAsync() without a BinNumber now returns the rates of every active POS of the merchant instead of the primary POS only, so the same Installment can appear on multiple rows. Use PosName/PosId to tell them apart

			Updated v1.0.1 =>
				- TransactionResult: added ChargedAmount, FormattedChargedAmount fields and GetChargedAmountDecimal() helper
				- RefundResponse: rewritten to expose full refund record (id, refund_amount, status, bank_response_*, currency_code, etc.)
				- CommissionResponse: added TransactionFee field
				- BinLookupResponse: added CardFamilyLogoPath field
				- CustomerResponse: added Ip, FormattedUpdatedAt fields
				- ProductResponse: added CurrencyId, ProductImageUrl fields
